statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
